Nvidia's GAAP operating margin in fiscal Q2 2027 (the quarter ended July 26, 2026) was about 66.2%.

- Operating income was $63,734 million, and revenue was $96,221 million.
- That gives 63,734 / 96,221 ≈ 66.2%.

The source is Nvidia's Q2 FY2027 earnings release and 10-Q. On a non-GAAP basis, operating income was $63,956 million, or about 66.5% of revenue.
